## Personality

An active worker in the church, Mrs. Lynde is known for being a farseeing, good, and kindly woman who possesses a kind heart and great generosity. While she can be bossy, outspoken, and given to gossiping in a matter-of-fact way, she is also benevolent, frequently assisting the poor and keeping a box of cookies ready in her cupboard. Additionally, she enjoys sewing and finds no trouble in doing it.

## History

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was married at the age of eighteen. Living in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she offered unsolicited advice to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) before [Anne](../character/anne.md) confronted Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) over a misunderstanding, and she later visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to praise Anne's growth and character at the end of a school term. When [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly sought her help to buy [Anne](../character/anne.md) a modern dress, Lynde sewed a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for the girl. As [Anne](../character/anne.md) matured, Lynde walked home with her while discussing church preparations, and she was present at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and the Keith twins to warmly welcome [Anne](../character/anne.md) back for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday during Anne's first term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Her misadventures in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) later became a topic of local news relayed to [Anne](../character/anne.md) by [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) while she was away at university.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P3](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

> "Things is pretty quiet in Avonlea. I don’t find Green Gables as lonesome as I expected. I think I’ll start another cotton warp quilt this winter. Mrs. Silas Sloane has a handsome new apple-leaf pattern."
>
> — Lynde — [v3 ch.Home P11](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0011)

> "It’s because you’re too heedless and impulsive, child, that’s what. You never stop to think—whatever comes into your head to say or do you say or do it without a moment’s reflection."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P62](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0062)

## Relationships

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--lynde.md)

Mrs. Lynde and [Emily](../character/emily.md) established a friendship after traveling to [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) together to shop for wallpaper. Their shared outing laid the foundation for a pleasant acquaintance.

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--paul-irving.md)

Mrs. Lynde shares a friendly bond with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), a young student in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She holds a fond affection for the imaginative boy.

- Friend of — fond of the young boy (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lynde.md)

Mrs. Lynde serves as a trusted neighbor and advisor to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), with [Anne](../character/anne.md) even consulting her when trying to rectify mistakes. Though occasionally critical in her observations, Mrs. Lynde praises Anne's personal growth over the years and sends her off with a hearty embrace and farewell when [Anne](../character/anne.md) departs for college.

- Friend of — gave Anne a hearty embrace and bade her farewell before she left for college (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002)</sub>
